about: Delivery presets for --target <name>: canvas size and fps (design pixels), and the safe rectangle where text and key objects belong (x, y, w, h from the top-left). Every zone here is an estimate until it is measured on the platform; an entry with "estimate": true has "measured": null. CFG.W, CFG.H and CFG.FPS in a scene win over these.

tiktok.source: Text column x 84-936 and bottom edge y 1480 from posted 1080x1920 pieces; top edge y 160 is a guess, not measured.

reels.source: Rough estimate (caption, buttons and profile row at the bottom; header at the top). Not measured.

shorts.source: Rough estimate (action buttons on the right, title and channel row at the bottom). Not measured.

youtube.source: Conventional title-safe area (5% margin each side). Not measured.

feed45.source: Conventional 5% margin on a 4:5 feed post. Not measured.

web.source: Conventional 5% margin for a site loop or hero video. Not measured.

none.source: No platform: size and fps come from CFG, and no safe area applies.
